name: oracle-fusion-agentic-toolkit
description: Agentic toolkit for an Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM functional consultant. Seven skills over one shared product knowledge base: root-cause debugging of a Jira ticket, configuration work, design advice, and Jira ingestion. Each ends in the keystrokes you run yourself and the full text of the message you send. Jira access is read-only, and no engagement data ships with the plugin.
